mission.title: Network Connections
mission.description: Steal Zion's latest information on Morpheus.

npc.say: I'll need to run some scans on this recording but I need some computer parts before I can run the scan. Go speak with Daren Swager and see if he has those computer parts for me.
You're back! Just stuff those computer parts into my computer and I'll take a look at 'em later.
There's some wicked stuff on that recording. I'm not sure what the Merovingian wants with it, but it's not my place to ask questions.
Quickly! Administer the medicine! He's bleeding to death!
Oh, man... The blood won't stop!
Ah! That helped a lot. Thanks for the hand, {player}.
Have you seen Daren's package? It's supposed to be enormous and it takes two people to carry it.

phase.briefing:
That wretch you spoke to in your previous assignment had some useful information, believe it or not. We've decided to follow up on the lead and liberate some information from Zion.
Break into the Zion base, search their network for recent information on Morpheus, and then... steal it.

enter.say: This place is wall to wall with Zion operatives; I don't think they'll be happy to see you here.

done.say: That Card should give you access to the Zion network on site.
The computer on the Zion network is in this room. We'll need access to the network before we can search their system files.

objective.text: Search the Zion network for information on Morpheus' murder

done.say: I think you just pissed them off.

objective.text: Take the Recording from the Computer

done.say: That recording must be what the Merovingian is looking for.

phase.briefing:
A colleague of mine needs to run a few scans on the recording you recovered. I'm sending you the address of Anhui now.
Let him take the Recording so he can do his job and then get it back from him. After you are done, I will have one final part to your assignment.

enter.say: Anhui is holed up in this Exile hideout. I'm seeing a few other signals in the area, so it's safe to say that he isn't alone.

talk.say: Flood told me to expect you. He said that you have a recording for me to analyze. Well, do you have it...?
Come on, come on! I haven't got all day.

done.say: I'll need to run some scans on this recording but I need some computer parts before I can run the scan. Go speak with Daren Swager and see if he has those computer parts for me. Once you get the parts, just stick 'em inside my computer.

talk.say: So Anhui wants his computer parts, eh? Well, before that bastard can have his precious computer parts, I need a little favor taken care of myself. If you can get my package from Ampell, consider those computer parts yours.
Are you going to stand around here all day or go pick up my package? I'm a busy man! Go!

Leon got cut up during our last run. If we had some Medical Supplies or Medicine, I could help him... You know, I bet Homer has some. If you can get some Medicine for my friend here, I'll give you the Package that Daren asked for. Deal?
I can give you some medicine... as long as it isn't for Leon.

done.say: Just don't give this to Leon. That jerk still hasn't coughed up the information he owes me.
Ah! That helped a lot. Thanks for the hand, {player}.
Thanks, {player}. Daren's package is all yours.

objective.text: Give the Package to Daren Swager

done.say: Haha, excellent! Yes, yes... This will do nicely. Now about those computer parts... You can have them now.

objective.text: Get the Computer Parts from Daren Swager
Put the Computer Parts in Anhui's computer

talk.say: Just in time too. I've finished my work on the recording. You can have it back now.

done.say: I wonder what Anhui means by that...
Flood has a final request of you which involves returning the recording to a Machine Network. I'm not sure why, but he has his reasons.
There's some wicked stuff on that recording. I'm not sure what the Merovingian wants with it, but it's not my place to ask questions.

phase.briefing:
With Zion upset about the heist you pulled, it may be in your best interest to leave the recording with the Machines and let the systematic programs sort it out.
Insert the recording into the local Machine network that has been pointed out to you. Your operator will have additional details when you reach the site.

enter.say: This should be a quick in and out job. Get to it.
A mainframe! Run a search on it and see if we can get onto the Machine network from here.

done.say: This mainframe has access to the Machine network. Insert the Recording into the Mainframe!

objective.text: Insert the Recording into the Mainframe

done.say: You pulled it off! Good work, {player}!
This laptop isn't even connected to the network. We need to find something much larger.

mission.finish:
Anhui tells me that the recording you stole has details on Morpheus and a member of Zion that Morpheus knew personally. This information leads us to believe that someone at Zion is responsible for Morpheus' death. It would behoove us to extort this person and exploit them for their actions.
We will find out which member of Zion is responsible for his death and make use of this information for our benefit. Trust in that.
